'''''White Nova''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] that followed. It would serve as the flagship of an Imperial fleet directing an [[Attack on the Dorin's Sky|attack]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Thranta-class corvette]] ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'' and later on the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] against the Republic blockade guarding it.<ref name="TOR:CtA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The White Nova first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as a flashpoint and operation starting area for Imperial players.
